name: toml-unsetpair
instr:
**Settings we never set come back as empty strings in the file our gateway writes**

Our billing gateway (Rust, toml crate) turns its settings into a `toml::Table` with
`Table::try_from`, lays the command-line overrides on top and writes the result back to
settings.toml with `toml::to_string`. Our deploy checks and the nightly report are Python and
read that file with `tomllib`.

Every setting nobody set now lands in the file as an empty string:

```toml
max_retries = ""
proxy_url = ""

[tls]
key_file = ""
```

tomllib returns those as values, so the deploy check thinks a proxy is configured and the report
falls over turning max_retries into a number.

The gateway itself reads the file back on the next start without complaint, which is why nobody
noticed at first.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, in the tests/ directory of the crate it exercises (say
crates/toml/tests/repro.rs), that fails on the current code because of this problem (a real test
failure, not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own
from a clean checkout with just your test files added.

I doubt I'm the only one hitting this. Anything else that goes through that code is probably
wrong too, so please fix it at
